questions.subject: PHYSICS_MECHANICS
questions.learningObjective: Identify the SI base unit of time
questions.stem: A dashboard note asks which unit is the SI base unit of time

options.misconception: confuses a derived common unit with the base unit
treats a larger derived unit as base
uses a calendar unit instead of SI base

questions.explanation: The second is the SI base unit of time. Minute, hour, and day are derived or non-SI units.
questions.hint: Base unit, not derived time unit.

questions.explanation: Acceleration is length over time squared. Metres per second is velocity, not acceleration.
